title: Privacy policy
description: How he4rt ink collects, uses, keeps and protects your data, and how you ask for access, correction or deletion.

summary.title: We only ask for what's needed
summary.text: Name, username, email and password. We don't keep your date of birth.

summary.title: Articles and comments are public
summary.text: They show your name and can be found by search engines.

summary.title: No ads and no tracking
summary.text: We only use essential cookies: session, theme and language.

summary.title: You can leave whenever you want
summary.text: Deleting the account takes 20 days; backups expire within 5 weeks.

sections.title: Who we are and how to reach us

blocks.p: he4rt ink is the technical articles platform of the He4rt community. We are the controller of the data processed here, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).
For any privacy matter, write to [{privacy_email}](mailto:{privacy_email}). It's the same channel as our data protection officer.

table.caption: Data we collect, when and what for
rows: Create and protect your account. The password is only stored encrypted.
Meet the minimum age. We don't ask for your date of birth.
Acceptance of the Terms and this policy
At sign-up and with each new version
Record the date and the version you accepted.
Review, publish and display your content.
Keep what you saved to read later.
Moderate the platform and answer your request.
IP address and date of suspicious login attempts
When something looks like an attack

list: **Public:** published articles, your profile (name, username, bio, links and photo) and your comments. Comments show your name to any visitor and can be indexed by search engines.
**Only you see:** drafts, articles under review or not approved, bookmarks, notifications and your email.
**Only moderation sees:** reports, appeals and the history of decisions about your account.

sections.title: What we use it for and on which legal basis

list: **Performing our contract with you** (LGPD, art. 7, V): keeping your account, reviewing and publishing your articles, sending account emails.
**Legitimate interest** (art. 7, IX): security, abuse prevention and moderation. We do this with as little data as possible.
**Complying with legal obligations** (art. 7, II): keeping records when the law requires it and answering authorities.

blocks.p: We don't sell data and we don't show ads.
We only use essential cookies, without which the site doesn't work. That's why we don't show a banner asking for consent.

table.caption: Essential cookies used on he4rt ink
rows: Until you log out or 2 weeks without use
Remember light, dark or device setting

blocks.note: If we ever count visits, that will get its own notice before it starts.

blocks.p: Only with companies that run the platform for us, under contract and only for that purpose:

list: Hosting of the site and the database.
Cloudflare R2, for images and backups, in separate accounts.
Service that sends account emails and notices.

blocks.p: We may also hand data to authorities under a court order or legal obligation.

table.caption: Data retention periods
rows: Permanent deletion; your articles become anonymous
Moderation records of a deleted account

blocks.p: Deleted data stays in backups until the copy expires, at most about 5 weeks. If a backup is restored, the deletion routines run again.
Under the LGPD (art. 18), you can ask for:

list: Confirmation that we process your data, and access to it.
Correction of incomplete or wrong data.
Anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data.
A copy of your data to take to another service.
Information about who we share it with.
Review of decisions made about you.

blocks.p: You change your name, username, email and password in Settings, and you delete the account there too. For anything else, write to [{privacy_email}](mailto:{privacy_email}): we answer within 15 days.
he4rt ink is for people aged 16 or older. Age is declared at sign-up and we don't keep the date of birth. If we learn of an account belonging to someone younger, it is deleted.

list: Always-encrypted connection (HTTPS) and passwords stored encrypted.
Daily backups in an account separate from the one that stores images.
Moderation access limited to what's needed, with every action logged.

blocks.p: If an incident could put you at risk, we tell you by email and notify Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
When we change something important, we tell you by email and ask you to accept the new version at your next login. Every version stays in the history below.
